// Command marelaysig is the reference side of the mirasim differential test.
//
// It lives OUTSIDE the ma-relay repository (which is live production and must
// never be modified) but declares a module path under
// github.com/SammySnake-d/ma-relay/..., which is what lets it import ma-relay's
// internal packages while a `replace` points the module at the read-only source
// tree. Everything it reports is produced by ma-relay's own executed code, not
// by a re-derivation.
//
// Protocol: one JSON job on stdin, one JSON result on stdout.
package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/SammySnake-d/ma-relay/internal/relay"
	"github.com/SammySnake-d/ma-relay/internal/relay/ccore"
)

type job struct {
	SeedB64    string `json:"seed_b64"`
	Method     string `json:"method"`
	Path       string `json:"path"`
	BodyB64    string `json:"body_b64"`
	Credential string `json:"credential"`
	Meta       string `json:"meta"`
	TSMillis   int64  `json:"ts_millis"`

	// Deterministic ccore.Seal probe.
	SealPubB64   string `json:"seal_pub_b64"`
	EphB64       string `json:"eph_b64"`
	SealNonceB64 string `json:"seal_nonce_b64"`
	PlaintextB64 string `json:"plaintext_b64"`
	AADB64       string `json:"aad_b64"`

	// Header set whose sealable subset should be observed.
	Headers map[string]string `json:"headers"`
}

type result struct {
	DeviceID     string            `json:"device_id"`
	PublicKeyB64 string            `json:"public_key_b64"`
	SigHeaders   map[string]string `json:"sig_headers"`
	SealBlobB64  string            `json:"seal_blob_b64"`
	SealedNames  []string          `json:"sealed_names"`
	SurvivingEnc string            `json:"surviving_enc"`
	Err          string            `json:"err,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	var j job
	if err := json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&j); err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	var out result

	signer, err := relay.NewDeviceSigner(j.SeedB64)
	if err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	out.DeviceID = signer.DeviceID
	out.PublicKeyB64 = signer.PublicKeyB64

	body, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(j.BodyB64)
	if err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	// ma-relay's DeviceSigner.Headers draws its 32-byte nonce from crypto/rand
	// with no injection point. The nonce it picked comes back in the header map,
	// so the port is driven with THAT nonce and the signatures stay comparable
	// byte for byte.
	hdrs, err := signer.Headers(j.Method, j.Path, body, j.Credential, j.Meta, time.UnixMilli(j.TSMillis))
	if err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	out.SigHeaders = hdrs

	if j.SealPubB64 != "" {
		pub := mustB64(j.SealPubB64)
		eph := mustB64(j.EphB64)
		nonce := mustB64(j.SealNonceB64)
		pt := mustB64(j.PlaintextB64)
		aad := mustB64(j.AADB64)
		blob, err := ccore.Seal(pub, eph, nonce, pt, aad)
		if err != nil {
			fail(err)
		}
		out.SealBlobB64 = base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(blob)
	}

	if len(j.Headers) > 0 {
		// ma-relay's plaintext collector is unexported, but SealHeaders DELETES
		// exactly the headers it sealed. Diffing the header map before/after is
		// therefore a direct observation of ma-relay's sealable key set — from
		// executed code, not from reading its source.
		h := http.Header{}
		for k, v := range j.Headers {
			h.Set(k, v)
		}
		before := map[string]bool{}
		for k := range h {
			before[strings.ToLower(k)] = true
		}
		if err := relay.SealHeaders(h, j.Method, j.Path); err != nil {
			fail(err)
		}
		after := map[string]bool{}
		for k := range h {
			after[strings.ToLower(k)] = true
		}
		for k := range before {
			if !after[k] {
				out.SealedNames = append(out.SealedNames, k)
			}
		}
		sort.Strings(out.SealedNames)
		out.SurvivingEnc = h.Get("x-mirasim-enc")
	}

	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(out); err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
}

func mustB64(s string) []byte {
	b, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(s)
	if err != nil {
		fail(err)
	}
	return b
}

func fail(err error) {
	_ = json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result{Err: err.Error()})
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "marelaysig:", err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
